coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall search, not production collection. Exactly 12 targeted fresh-web searches completed for sole/last/full-service grocery losses, storm/fire/outage food-distribution cancellations, abrupt pantry/food-bank access closures, and new official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruptions. No newly published, directly corroborated qualifying disruption in the target hour. Retrieved items mostly dated earlier; a Texas SNAP enrollment/backlog story published 2026-10-23 05:00 local was outside the window and did not establish a newly issued official interruption. Excluded stale disruptions, resource/promotion stories, generic food-policy coverage, and duplicates. Search-index freshness limits completeness. No editorial approval, publishing, schedule change or task disabling.
